businesses.business: online professional network and digital platform for medical professionals

offering_description.value: Operates a professional network for US physicians and other clinicians, offering tools such as news, telehealth, workflow and AI assistants. Sells marketing and hiring solutions to pharmaceutical manufacturers, health systems and staffing firms, delivered through its online platform.

primary_products.value: clinician networking platform; pharma marketing software; talent recruitment solutions; telehealth tools; AI clinical assistant software

primary_services.value: digital advertising and marketing services for pharma; healthcare recruiting and hiring services

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical manufacturers, health systems, hospitals, staffing and recruiting firms; B2C: physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants and pharmacists using the free network

end_markets.value: healthcare; pharmaceutical marketing; healthcare staffing and recruiting

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual pharma marketing and hiring solution subscriptions with sponsored content and recruiting access; advertising: sponsored content and digital promotion delivered to clinicians

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs a clinician network and workflow platform, selling access to its audience to life sciences and health systems

geography_served.value: US national: United States clinician network, customers mainly US-based

specialization.value: related lines: marketing solutions, hiring solutions and clinician workflow tools on one network

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to pharma companies and health systems; online: free web and mobile app for clinicians

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: healthcare data privacy (HIPAA), pharma promotion rules (FDA), telehealth and advertising rules
